questions.stem: At 2989 lines, which claim about conditional is valid?

options.text: Runs a block when condition is true

questions.explanation: conditional: A conditional executes a block only when its boolean expression is true, otherwise optionally executing an else branch. With 2989 lines in view, that principle distinguishes the correct choice; every other option rests on a specific misconception.
questions.hint: How many branches run per evaluation?
